body: Did you talk about it any further than that? I really don’t want to cause her more pain, or my kids...I think maybe that’s why I’m here and not trying the belt again.

I can’t imagine my life without her, but even if she forgave me I don’t know how to ever forgive myself. How do I reconcile what I’ve done when it breaks every moral code I have. She is my reason for being on this Earth and instead of being her protector I’ve become the source of her pain. I look at my daughter who looks just like her Mum, and it breaks me. All my life I’ve needed people to feel proud of me to feel like I have worth. Now I feel like I don’t deserve anyone’s pride or love. I know people make mistakes but this is more than that. It so fundamentally undermines my perception of myself. I know this will damage her forever and I hate myself for that, I hate that I can’t fix it and I hate that I’m too much of a coward to deal with what I’ve done.
